==Description==
'''UI-20''' is the 2nd April Fools exclusive entities that reside within [[Section UI]]. More information about '''UI-20''' will be presented below.

==Behavior==
When '''UI-20''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed. It will also emit a strange fast laughing sound upon any players being in close proximity.

Once '''UI-20''' starts moving, it will begin to rush to the current room, faster than the players can sprint. Once '''UI-20''' reaches the current room's door, it will disappear and stop emitting all its sounds. This entity overall behaves very similar to UI-5, but the way it moves is faster.

==Strategy & Tips==
*Once you hear '''UI-20''', hide, as it will approach the current room at a decent speed. '''UI-20''' isn't also a huge threat, and is overall very easy to avoid, as it doesn't check any hiding spots and isn't very fast.
*Don't try to outrun '''UI-20''', as it moves faster than you can sprint.
**This idea is also very bad, especially further into the rooms.
*'''UI-20''' can be seen from far away before it makes noise, so it is very easy to tell when to act against it.

==Trivia==
* '''UI-20''' was added as a joke, since the entity and the I-Section came out on April 1st, 2024, when SUPER EPIC MODE was released.
*'''UI-20'''<nowiki/>'s appearance can be compared with other entities from different Rooms fangames, like '''UI-10''' from INTERMINABLE ROOMS.
* Unlike most entities using a directional image to display its appearance, '''UI-20''' uses an invisible block with decals on all sides, giving the entity a straightforward, yet goofy appearance.
